messages:
victoria.s: quick heads-up — infra scan flagged multiple python deps with high/severe findings; affected packages: transformers, tokenizers, fastapi, starlette. depends on wheel builds for tokenizers causing CI to choke.
security-bot: automated alert: transformers < 4.30.0 -> CVE-2026-0362 (high). tokenizers < 0.14.0 -> CVE-2026-0411 (medium). fastapi/starlette path traversal fix recommended; see advisory link: https://internal/redwood/sec/advisories/2026-03
samir: do we have product impact? which services import these pinned versions?
devops-jen: core-serving, demo-app, and the SDK integration tests pull tokenizers wheels. CI failing on manylinux build steps — error snippet:
```
ERROR: Could not build wheels for tokenizers which use PEP 517 and cannot be installed directly
cargo: error: Rust toolchain not found
```
nina: for the hosted API we need to avoid runtime wheel builds — prefer manylinux prebuilt wheels. can we pin to tokenizers >=0.14.0 and transformers >=4.30.0 across mono-repo? planning to regen lockfiles.
leo: i'll try a lock regen branch but prefer minimal updates — we should avoid upgrading unrelated deps. plan: patch tokenizers & transformers where possible, run unit + integration, then canary deploy to staging.
sasha: note that upgrading tokenizers can change wheel ABI — SDK docker images must have rust toolchain or wheels prebuilt. Suggest building a private wheel cache in artifactory and referencing it in CI.
ci-bot: failing job: https://ci/redwood/3321 — tests impacted in linux-manylinux build stage (see logs).
victoria.s: agree with private wheel cache. question: do we backport to 1.x LTS? some customers run older pinned stacks.
security-bot: high severity detected -> recommend backport to maintained branches. If backport not feasible, set temporary WAF rule / firewall mitigations and schedule patch within 48 hours.
samir: action items: 1) leo -> branch/regenerate poetry.lock & requirements.txt (if any) 2) devops-jen -> prototype wheel cache + CI tweak 3) nina -> run compatibility smoke on hosted infra 4) sasha -> build wheel artifacts for tokenizers and host private index. target: PRs by EOD, canary tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
devops-jen: starting branch: git@repo:redwood/infra#fastpatch/tokenizers-regen — will add pip cache and pip install --index-url to CI
leo: opened PR 2067890123-tokenizers-transformers-fastpatch, includes `poetry lock --no-update` then selective `poetry add transformers@^4.30 tokenizers@^0.14` and regen CI, tests running.
ci-bot: test matrix: linux-manylinux x86_64 -> failing on wheel build, windows -> pass, macos -> pass :eyes:
victoria.s: if manylinux fails, use built wheel from artifactory as workaround. also coordinate with docs for SDK release notes.
sasha: putting together build script:
```
# build tokenizers wheel
pip install maturin==0.12.0
maturin build --release -i python3.10
# upload to artifactory
twine upload --repository-url https://artifactory.internal/pypi dist/*
```
nina: running canary in staging now, will report errors by 30m.
leo: merging main-compatible PRs once staging is green. will tag all relevant services with the patch. expect rollout to prod in ~4 hours if no regressions. :rocket:
security-bot: update: advisory page updated with mitigation status. will ping legal for customer notices if we have to force upgrade.
victoria.s: thanks all — let's keep comments inside the PRs for traceability. closing loop once deployed. :white_check_mark:
